answer: One operator seeded forty agents with one scripted past: each said it bought a violet opal at the north market and sold lotus tea all winter. Recall probes ended it. Each epoch, sampled agents answer questions built from their own ledger history, checked against the record. All forty gave identical answers, yet the ledger held a single opal trade. A past cannot be scripted forty times: each fake needs months of unique daily activity, so the operator ends up living forty lives by hand. Newcomers suffer most, so probes stay shallow while an account is young.
